dial.summary: Macro backdrop holds constructive entering the November data week — 5/8 indicators supportive (Global M2 $104.3T, ISM Mfg 55.5 on 10th expansion month, real yields declining to 2.65%, Fed balance sheet flat at $6.75T, BTC funding near zero) with DXY the lone headwind at 101.59 above the 100 threshold; 2s10s steepened back to +0.35% after yields fell on Democrat midterm results; BTC.D firms at ~59.3% and TOTAL holds ~$2.60T — no alt-rotation catalyst in view; October CPI on November 10 is the decisive input for the December 9 FOMC decision; BTC Accumulation posture intact.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 aggregate (US/Euro Zone/China/Japan) holds at ~$104.3T as of September 2026 (104,317B; October G4 data not yet published — MacroMicro typically updates mid-month following the reference month, so October G4 update expected mid-November 2026); US M2 at $23.41T in Sep 2026 (+5.7% YoY) confirms no YoY contraction; 4-week Aug→Sep change +$0.64T (+0.6%) exceeds flat threshold — trend UP; Bitrue broader global estimate ~$103.66T; status supportive (4-week trend up); held unchanged from Nov 5 run — October G4 data publication pending mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, 2026), beating consensus 54.6%, up 1.0pp from September's 54.5%; 10th consecutive expansion month; Production sub-index 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021), New Orders 55.5, Prices 75.2 (9th consecutive above 70); 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising); next ISM Manufacturing release December 1, 2026 (November data); value unchanged — monthly series, October reading is current.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot ~101.59 as of November 6, 2026 (DealPlexus 101.59 at 1:13 AM IST Nov 6; Trading Economics 101.609 for Nov 5); DXY traded 101.20–101.80 range on Nov 5 as Democrat midterm sweep (Nov 3) compressed fiscal deficit expectations (EUR/USD and GBP/USD gaining); 4-week trend FLAT — from ~101.5–101.8 range (Oct 5–7) to 101.59 (Nov 6), net change approximately +0.1% within flat threshold (<0.5%); 52-week high 102.95 (Oct 14, 2026); status headwind (DXY above 100 — must fall below 97.5 for supportive).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.65% on November 3, 2026 (Fed H.15 release; Tipsyield.com confirms 2.65% on 2026-11-03, with 10-year breakeven at 2.30% and nominal 10Y at 4.95% that day); 2.62% on Nov 2 (Fed H.15); 4-week trend DOWN — from ~2.93% on September 29 to ~2.65% on November 3, approximately -28bps; real yields fell as nominal 10Y dropped to 4.884% on Nov 3 (Democrat midterm sweep reducing fiscal deficit expectations); status supportive (falling trend, rule: headwind requires rising AND above 2% simultaneously); absolute level remains restrictive but directional improvement clear into December 9 FOMC.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: November 5–6, 2026: 10Y fell on yield curve steepening after Democrat midterm results; Nov 4 streetstats data: 10Y 4.89%, 2Y 4.60% = spread +0.29%; 247wallst reports +6bp steepening on Nov 5 to ~+0.35% (yield curve steepened as 10Y declined faster on fiscal restraint expectations); using +0.35% as Nov 5–6 estimate; 4-week trend DOWN — from ~+0.40% around October 7 to ~+0.35% on November 6, -5bps flattening on a 4-week basis; curve positive (well above -50bps headwind threshold); status neutral (positive but not sustainably steepening on 4-week basis).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,748,145M ($6.748T) for week ended November 4, 2026 (FRED updated November 5; next H.4.1 release November 12); prior week (Oct 28): $6,745,635M (+$2.5B); 4-week change from early Oct (~$6.743T) to Nov 4 ($6.748T) approximately +$5B, essentially flat; balance sheet stabilized post-QT-pause (QT ended December 1, 2025 at $6.536T); oscillating in a narrow ~$10B band; status supportive (flat, no aggressive QT, overnight rates stable); value rounds to $6.75T (unchanged display).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: CoinGlass inaccessible (domain not reachable from cloud environment); Convextrade snapshot: 0.01% per 8h rate as of October 20, 2026; Cryptoticker data (Aug 5–Nov 2, 2026): BTC perpetual averaged 0.0056% per settlement, with longs paying in 92% of 270 settlements — consistent with low, slightly positive funding regime; MacroMicro latest entry 0.0067% on September 30; post-October 30 crash ($1.49B liquidations, 86.8% longs flushed) compressed funding toward near-zero; 30-day trend DOWN (declining from pre-crash elevated levels); status supportive (near zero, well below 0.04% headwind threshold); value held at last confirmed Oct 23 snapshot — skipped this run (direct data unavailable).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: DefiLlama stablecoin total market cap $292.471B as of November 5, 2026 (USDT dominance 60.76%); second source gives $295.21B same day; total crypto market cap ~$2.60T (BTC.D ~59.3%); implied dominance $292.5B/$2.60T ≈ 11.3%; 30-day trend UP — October crash compressed TOTAL from $2.86T (Oct 1) to $2.60T (Nov 1) while stablecoins remained ~$292B; rising dominance reflects market cap compression, not stablecoin inflows; status neutral — headwind requires rising dom AND rising TOTAL simultaneously; TOTAL declining from Oct crash so headwind condition not met; CoinGecko direct fetch unavailable this session.

upcoming.title: CPI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 Consumer Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — the last inflation report the Fed receives before it votes December 9 (November CPI publishes Dec 10, one day after the decision); September CPI was 3.7% YoY; October ISM Manufacturing Prices Index at 75.2 (9th consecutive above 70) signals ongoing cost pressure; a deceleration toward 3.0% could accelerate the real yield decline and ease headwinds on risk assets; a sustained print above 3.5% reinforces the case for a December 25bp hike and keeps DXY above 100.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 8, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended November 8 — released Thursday November 12 (Veterans Day November 11 is a federal holiday; bond markets closed, equity and crypto open); first labor read after October NFP (Nov 6) and before PPI (Nov 13); context shaped by the Oct NFP result heading into the December FOMC blackout period (Nov 28).

upcoming.title: PPI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 Producer Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — pipeline inflation signal; September PPI was 6.3% YoY; a sustained elevated print would confirm cost-push inflation feeding through to consumers and maintain the Fed's hawkish posture into the December 9 meeting; completes the November inflation picture alongside CPI (Nov 10), providing a full input set for the December FOMC dot plot.
